services.desc: At the Flying Lady we only provide the best quality boats available. We work hard to keep our boats clean and up-to-date on all maintenance so your trip will be perfect. The Flying Lady is a 27′ Abel Marine that was pressed into service for Florida Boat Tours in Jupiter. Built in 1977 in Southwest Harbor, Maine, the Flying Lady is over 40 years old. Undoubtedly, Abel has produced some of the most beautiful vessels ever built. Unlike the competition, Abel Marine had a reputation for building the highest quality boat available. blurb: Flying Lady Boat Tours offers narrated sightseeing boat tours including historic and celebrity home tours, sunset cruises, and sandbar and swim experiences. Tours depart from Guanabanas in Jupiter and Riviera Beach Marina in West Palm Beach. Wildlife sightings may include manatees, turtles, dolphins, and coastal birds.
